requirements.evidence: All contract items are implemented: `database/migrations/2026_10_29_041244_create_entities_table.php:14-20` has id/name/unique slug (`entities_slug_unique`)/timestamps/soft deletes, and `database/migrations/2026_10_29_041245_create_entity_memberships_table.php:14-27` has cascading FKs, role default `employee`, the stored generated `owner_seq`, and both named unique indexes. Models: `app/Models/Entity.php:14-54` (Fillable, SoftDeletes, slug route key, memberships/users/owner), `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12-68` (role cast, owner/admin/employee scopes, entity/user relations), `app/Models/User.php:38-58` (memberships/entities/membershipFor), `app/Models/UserRole.php:5-19`. Policies: `app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:14-54` and `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-43`. Factories: `database/factories/EntityFactory.php:18-24` and `database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:21-43`. Docs and changelog are updated, and edge cases (second owner, multiple non-owners, cascades, soft delete, self-removal) are tested.

conventions.evidence: Uses reversible generated-style migrations (`down()` at `database/migrations/2026_10_29_041244_create_entities_table.php:26-29` and `2026_10_29_041245_create_entity_memberships_table.php:34-37`), policies for authorization, deliberate mass-assignment declarations (`app/Models/Entity.php:14`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12`) matching the existing `User` model's `#[Fillable]` style, Pest tests with `RefreshDatabase`, and keeps docs in sync (`docs/database-schema.md:3,137,149-155`; `CHANGELOG.md:12`). One minor deviation: the factory state methods at `database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:30-43` have no PHPDoc even though the convention asks for PHPDoc on public methods touched (the surrounding methods are documented).

security.evidence: Authorization is policy-based and always checks membership of the relevant entity: `app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:22-25,30-41,46-49` and `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:14-17,22-25,31-43`; non-members are denied and the owner's membership can never be deleted. Mass assignment is constrained (`app/Models/Entity.php:14`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:12`; `owner_seq` is not fillable) and the database enforces the one-owner invariant. This change has no views, Livewire components or untrusted request input. Unauthorized paths are tested (`tests/Feature/Policies/EntityPolicyTest.php:35-45,47-53`; `tests/Feature/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicyTest.php:50-61`).

tests.evidence: Three Pest suites use `RefreshDatabase`. `tests/Feature/Models/EntityTest.php` covers factory, route key and soft delete (14-37), relations and role scopes (39-81), DB constraints and owner edge cases (88-129), cascades (131-139) and the DB role default (141-148). `tests/Feature/Policies/EntityPolicyTest.php:20-33` is a full owner/admin/employee matrix, with non-member and cross-entity denial (35-53) and gate discovery (55-60). `tests/Feature/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicyTest.php:11-24` covers the membership matrix, owner protection (26-34), self-removal (36-40), outsider denial (50-61) and gate discovery (63-69). Assertions are meaningful and no tests are skipped or weakened.

simplicity.evidence: The change reuses existing building blocks (`User::membershipFor`, enum casts, Laravel factories and local scopes) and keeps migrations and policies minimal. The only duplication found is the owner-or-admin check implemented privately in both policies (`app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:51-54` and `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:40-43`), which could drift over time.

readability.evidence: Clear names and short focused methods; public relations, scopes and policy methods are documented (`app/Models/Entity.php:20-54`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php:18-68`, `app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-49`, `app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-38`), formatting matches the existing `User` model, and the tests read as behavior statements. No debug output or dead code.

scope.evidence: Only task-relevant files appear in `change.diff`: the two migrations under `database/migrations/2026_10_29_0412*`, `app/Models/Entity.php`, `app/Models/EntityMembership.php`, `app/Models/UserRole.php`, the `User` model relations, the two factories, the two policies, three test files, and the required `docs/database-schema.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` updates. No routes, pages, session handling or unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The owner-or-admin check is duplicated in both policies; extracting it (for example to a `User` or `UserRole` helper) would keep the authorization rule in one place and prevent future drift.

The `owner()`, `admin()` and `employee()` factory state methods lack PHPDoc, while the conventions ask for PHPDoc on public methods touched; this is only a consistency nit because the methods are self-explanatory.

review.summary: This change implements the entity/membership persistence layer, Eloquent models, `UserRole` enum, factories and both authorization policies, with thorough Pest coverage and updated schema documentation and changelog. Every task requirement and contract item is present and the authorization paths are well tested; I would approve it after two minor, non-blocking cleanups (deduplicating the owner-or-admin helper and documenting the factory states).
